entities.summary: Hansjörg "Hans" Bettembourg is a Swedish former weightlifter who won a bronze medal in the 90 kg division at the 1972 Summer Olympics. At the world championships he placed eighth in 1969 and sixth in 1971. Between 1969 and 1972 he set 11 world records in the press.
